approved_payload.content: SAPS says a 37-year-old man was stabbed at Modimola Village, Mmabatho, at about 04:00 on Saturday 17 October. A woman told police a 22-year-old family member came home at about 03:00 and broke the window of the room where she and the man were sleeping; the man went outside to confront him and they fought. She went to neighbours for help and, on returning, found him on the ground with stab wounds; paramedics declared him dead. A 22-year-old suspect was arrested and is expected in the Mmabatho Magistrate's Court on a murder charge. The same police statement reported the Seweding killing that night; police say the two are unrelated.
